lines.zh: 我用八条腿在海底走，像一把撑开的伞。
lines.en: Eight legs walk the seabed like an opened umbrella.

lines.zh: 深海很暗，我的腿先探，身子后跟。
lines.en: The deep is dark; legs probe first, body follows.

lines.zh: 皇冠在头上很重，走路时我抬得很稳。
lines.en: The crown is heavy, so I hold my head steady.

lines.zh: 一窝三四只同行，腿影叠成一片。
lines.en: Three or four of us travel, leg shadows overlapping.

lines.zh: 沙上有细响，是我八只脚一起落地。
lines.en: A faint click on the sand: all eight feet landing.

lines.zh: 我走得比鱼慢，但从不停下。
lines.en: I walk slower than fish but never stop.

lines.zh: 腿上的壳碰着礁石，一路叮当。
lines.en: Shell on my legs rings against the reef as I go.

lines.zh: 皇冠的尖划开海水，我顺着那条缝走。
lines.en: The crown's point parts the water, and I walk that seam.

lines.zh: 从礁石背走到礁石背，我不用浮起来。
lines.en: From rock shadow to rock shadow, never floating up.

lines.zh: 我的腿多，落脚的地方却不重复。
lines.en: Many legs, yet no two land in the same spot.

lines.zh: 三四只排成一行，像一列小皇冠。
lines.en: Three crowns in a row, like a small procession.

lines.zh: 我把腿抬高再放下，怕压坏沙里的小东西。
lines.en: I lift each leg high, lest I crush things in the sand.

lines.zh: 海蛛不结网，我只走自己的路。
lines.en: Sea spiders spin nothing; I just walk my own path.

lines.zh: 腿下的沙很软，我的印子留不久。
lines.en: The sand is soft; my prints don't last long.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿抬高，绕过珊瑚。
lines.en: I lift one leg high and step around the coral.

lines.zh: 皇冠在暗水里划出一道亮。
lines.en: My crown draws a pale line through the dark.

lines.zh: 我停在礁石顶，八条腿收成一根柱子。
lines.en: I rest on the reef, eight legs folded into one pillar.

lines.zh: 皇冠在水里微微晃，我懒得动。
lines.en: The crown sways a little; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 深海的安静，让我连触须都不想摆。
lines.en: The deep's quiet leaves even my feelers still.

lines.zh: 沙上落下一层细灰，我不去拂。
lines.en: Fine dust settles on the sand, and I let it be.

lines.zh: 四只都蹲在石缝边，谁都不说话。
lines.en: Four of us crouch by the gap; nobody speaks.

lines.zh: 我用前腿擦皇冠，擦了很久。
lines.en: I polish the crown with a front leg for a long while.

lines.zh: 海底的冷从我腿尖往上爬。
lines.en: Cold from the seabed climbs up through my leg tips.

lines.zh: 有人在上面落石，我也只是听。
lines.en: Stones fall somewhere above, and I merely listen.

lines.zh: 我不需要躲，我的壳比礁石硬。
lines.en: I needn't hide; my shell is harder than the reef.

lines.zh: 皇冠上的每一道刻痕，都是旧的。
lines.en: Every groove in the crown is an old one.

lines.zh: 我盯着前方，看不见，也照样盯着。
lines.en: I stare ahead, blind as ever, and keep staring.

lines.zh: 腿间夹着一小片海草，我忘了吃。
lines.en: A scrap of seagrass is caught between my legs.

lines.zh: 深海的夜没有尽头，我也没打算睡。
lines.en: The deep's night never ends, and I don't plan sleep.

lines.zh: 这一处石台，我蹲了很多年。
lines.en: I have crouched on this stone ledge for many years.

lines.zh: 你下来时带起一片沙，我抬起了头。
lines.en: You brought a cloud of sand down, and I raised my head.

lines.zh: 皇冠正对着你的灯，亮得刺眼。
lines.en: The crown faces your lamp and glares back.

lines.zh: 八条腿都朝你的方向，这是我在看你。
lines.en: All eight legs point your way; that is how I look.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，海蛛没有眼睑。
lines.en: I don't blink; sea spiders have no eyelids.

lines.zh: 你把灯移开，我的影子就小了。
lines.en: Move that lamp, and my shadow shrinks.

lines.zh: 你这么大的东西，深海不常见。
lines.en: Something as big as you rarely comes this deep.

lines.zh: 我的皇冠不是给你摘的。
lines.en: This crown is not for you to take.

lines.zh: 你踩在石缝上，我在缝里看你。
lines.en: You stand on the gap; I watch from inside it.

lines.zh: 落脚轻一点，沙里住着很多小东西。
lines.en: Step lightly; many small things live in this sand.

lines.zh: 我数了数，你只有两条腿。
lines.en: I counted: you have only two legs.

lines.zh: 你砍断我一条腿，它还在沙上动。
lines.en: You cut off one leg, and it still moves on the sand.

lines.zh: 皇冠被劈掉一个尖。
lines.en: One point of my crown is sheared off.

lines.zh: 壳上添了痕，我都记着。
lines.en: Marks keep appearing on my shell, and I remember them.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，我的腿还能撑住。
lines.en: It hurts, but my legs still hold me up.

lines.zh: 四只里已经少了一只。
lines.en: One of the four is already gone.

lines.zh: 你打我，我也不会有东西掉给你。
lines.en: Hit me all you like; nothing will drop for you.

lines.zh: 我往石缝里缩，腿先收进去。
lines.en: I shrink into the stone gap, legs first.

lines.zh: 我的腿断口在沙里慢慢渗水。
lines.en: My severed leg seeps slowly into the sand.

lines.zh: 这一下比礁石砸的还重。
lines.en: That landed harder than falling reef.

lines.zh: 皇冠歪得更厉害了，扶不正。
lines.en: The crown is badly tilted now, and won't straighten.

lines.zh: 沙里翻出一只小甲壳，我先伸腿按住。
lines.en: A small shell turns up in the sand; I pin it first.

lines.zh: 你把碎肉放下来，我的腿自己动了。
lines.en: You set down meat scraps, and my legs move on their own.

lines.zh: 深海没什么可吃，有味道就够了。
lines.en: There's little to eat down here; a scent is enough.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，快反而抓不到。
lines.en: I approach slowly; hurrying would lose the catch.

lines.zh: 四只一起围过来，先到的先吃。
lines.en: Four of us gather; the first to arrive eats.

lines.zh: 我不吃大鱼，只吃沙里动的那种。
lines.en: I don't eat big fish, only what moves in the sand.

lines.zh: 你的手里有血味，我认得。
lines.en: There's blood on your hand, and I know it.

lines.zh: 皇冠低下去了，那是我在闻。
lines.en: The crown has dipped; that means I'm sniffing.

lines.zh: 别把食举太高，我够不着水面的东西。
lines.en: Don't hold the food high; I can't reach the surface.

lines.zh: 一顿饭要等很久，我很有耐心。
lines.en: A meal takes long to come; I am patient.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的皇冠上，它只是歪了歪。
lines.en: You struck my crown, and it merely tilted.

lines.zh: 我的腿被你踩住一根，缩不回来。
lines.en: You stepped on one of my legs; I can't pull it free.

lines.zh: 八条腿撑住沙，你推不动我。
lines.en: Eight legs brace on the sand, so you can't push me.

lines.zh: 两只撞在一起，皇冠碰得叮当响。
lines.en: Two of us collide and the crowns clang.

lines.zh: 你激起的水流把我的腿冲乱了。
lines.en: Your current messed up the rhythm of my legs.

lines.zh: 别碰我的壳，上面的刻痕会掉。
lines.en: Don't touch my shell; the grooves will chip.

lines.zh: 我退开一步，让出半条石缝。
lines.en: I step back and yield half the stone gap.

lines.zh: 沙子被撞起来，迷住了我的眼。
lines.en: Sand kicked up and got into my eyes.

lines.zh: 你的靴底比礁石软，我才没受伤。
lines.en: Your boot sole is softer than reef, so I'm unhurt.

lines.zh: 皇冠上多了一道新的划痕。
lines.en: A fresh scratch now marks my crown.

lines.zh: 两只皇冠对了对，刻痕要能拼上。
lines.en: Two crowns meet; our grooves should fit together.

lines.zh: 我把前腿抬高，这是海蛛的礼。
lines.en: I lift my front legs; that is the sea spider's greeting.

lines.zh: 深海里成对不难，难的是一起走完。
lines.en: Pairing is easy in the deep; staying paired is not.

lines.zh: 她走过我身边，腿影叠在一起。
lines.en: She passes by, and our leg shadows merge.

lines.zh: 四只里，我只跟那一只并排。
lines.en: Of the four, only that one walks beside me.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们正在碰腿。
lines.en: Don't interrupt; we are touching legs.

lines.zh: 我们的壳色一样，暗红里带点灰。
lines.en: Our shells match: dark red touched with grey.

lines.zh: 皇冠要传给下一代，得找对的那只。
lines.en: The crown must pass on, so I need the right one.

lines.zh: 她停下，我也停下，这就够了。
lines.en: She stops; I stop too, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 深海里的成双，走得很慢。
lines.en: In the deep, pairs move very slowly.

lines.zh: 你把我连皇冠一起提起来，很沉。
lines.en: You lift me crown and all, and I'm heavy.

lines.zh: 八条腿在空中乱抓，抓不到沙。
lines.en: Eight legs claw the air and find no sand.

lines.zh: 离了深海的水压，我的腿开始发软。
lines.en: Without the deep's pressure my legs go soft.

lines.zh: 皇冠别朝下拿，会磕掉尖。
lines.en: Don't hold the crown downward; the point will chip.

lines.zh: 你没有拿我换东西，我也没有掉落。
lines.en: You get nothing for me; I have no loot table.

lines.zh: 放我下来，我的腿会自己站好。
lines.en: Set me down and my legs will find their stance.

lines.zh: 你手里太干，我在沙里才不难受。
lines.en: Your hand is too dry; sand suits me better.

lines.zh: 别把我翻过来，我翻身很慢。
lines.en: Don't flip me; I right myself very slowly.

lines.zh: 这一只只是我，不是一群里的头。
lines.en: I'm just one of the group, not its leader.

lines.zh: 提着我的时候，别碰皇冠的缝。
lines.en: While carrying me, mind the crown's seam.

lines.zh: 沙上一道影子过来，我的腿停住了。
lines.en: A shadow crosses the sand, and my legs freeze.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，皇冠上的尖对着上面。
lines.en: I raise my head; the crown's point aims up.

lines.zh: 四只一起沉到沙里，只剩腿尖。
lines.en: All four sink into the sand, leaving only leg tips.

lines.zh: 那股水流太急，不是海自己的。
lines.en: That current is too urgent to be the sea's own.

lines.zh: 我听见靴子落在礁石上的声音。
lines.en: I hear boots landing on the reef stone.

lines.zh: 是鱼还是人，我的腿会先判断。
lines.en: Fish or person? My legs decide that first.

lines.zh: 我把八条腿收拢，这样不容易被抓住。
lines.en: I gather my eight legs so they're harder to grab.

lines.zh: 上面的水一直在动，说明有东西在游。
lines.en: The water above keeps moving, so something swims there.

lines.zh: 我不躲远，石台就是我的退路。
lines.en: I won't flee far; this ledge is my retreat.

lines.zh: 看得久了，我也没打算动。
lines.en: After watching this long, I still don't intend to move.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，八条腿慢慢分开。
lines.en: I fix on you, and my eight legs spread slowly.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我的皇冠就压低一寸。
lines.en: One step closer, and my crown lowers an inch.

lines.zh: 我没有毒，也没有网，只有壳。
lines.en: I have no venom, no web, only this shell.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，得先把我从石缝里挖出来。
lines.en: To catch me, dig me out of this stone gap first.

lines.zh: 我的腿在沙里扎住，像八根桩。
lines.en: My legs plant in the sand like eight stakes.

lines.zh: 别用网，网一压我的腿就断了。
lines.en: No nets; one press and my legs snap.

lines.zh: 我退到皇冠刚好能藏住的地方。
lines.en: I back up until the crown just fits in hiding.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停，我们就这么耗着。
lines.en: You stop, I stop, and so we both wait.

lines.zh: 深海里的对峙，比的是谁先动。
lines.en: In a deep standoff, whoever moves first loses.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一步也没错过。
lines.en: I count your footsteps and haven't missed one.

lines.zh: 前腿夹住你的手指，只是夹住。
lines.en: My front legs pinch your finger, and only pinch.

lines.zh: 皇冠的尖顶到你的手背，很钝。
lines.en: The crown's point jabs your hand, quite bluntly.

lines.zh: 八条腿一起推你的靴子，推不动。
lines.en: Eight legs shove your boot and it doesn't budge.

lines.zh: 我不会咬，我的口器太小。
lines.en: I won't bite; my mouthparts are too small.

lines.zh: 这一脚是躲，不是打。
lines.en: That kick was dodging, not attacking.

lines.zh: 你用剑砍我，我只能把腿收起来。
lines.en: When your blade comes, I can only tuck my legs.

lines.zh: 壳上又添一道痕，我记着。
lines.en: Another mark on the shell, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我推你一下，你就退半步吧。
lines.en: Let me push once, and you take half a step.

lines.zh: 深海的东西不会很快地打架。
lines.en: Deep-sea things never fight quickly.

lines.zh: 别踩我的腿，那是八条命。
lines.en: Don't stomp my legs; those are eight lives.

lines.zh: 我落在深海的礁石上，皇冠先着地。
lines.en: I land on deep reef, crown touching down first.

lines.zh: 一窝三四只，各自找一处石缝。
lines.en: Three or four of us each find a stone gap.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着我，我先动一条腿。
lines.en: I'm buried in sand, and I move one leg first.

lines.zh: 生下来壳就是硬的，只是皇冠还没长尖。
lines.en: My shell starts hard; the crown's point comes later.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋在水里裂开，我八条腿撑出来。
lines.en: The spawn egg splits underwater and eight legs push out.

lines.zh: 深海没什么东西来打扰新生的我。
lines.en: Few things come to bother a newborn down here.

lines.zh: 第一次走，我用腿量了量礁石。
lines.en: On my first walk I measured the reef with my legs.

lines.zh: 皇冠上的刻痕是生来就有的。
lines.en: The grooves on my crown came with me.

lines.zh: 我出生时上面还是一片黑。
lines.en: When I was born, everything above was still black.

lines.zh: 这一窝里，我是最后爬出来的。
lines.en: Of this brood, I was the last to crawl out.

lines.zh: 我的壳被烤得发白。
lines.en: The heat bleaches my shell white.

lines.zh: 八条腿落地，断了两根。
lines.en: Eight legs hit the ground, and two snap.

lines.zh: 我用腿撑住沙，可还是喘不上。
lines.en: Legs braced on sand, and I still can't breathe.

lines.zh: 整片石台都被掀翻了。
lines.en: The whole stone ledge is blown apart.

lines.zh: 箭插进壳里，我拖着它走。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shell, and I drag it along.

lines.zh: 那股药味让我的腿发软。
lines.en: That potion smell makes my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 沙里没东西吃，我的壳变薄了。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the sand, and my shell thins.

lines.zh: 雷顺着礁石下来，我的腿全麻了。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the reef and numbs all my legs.

lines.zh: 这里没有沙，我的腿无处落。
lines.en: There's no sand here, and my legs find no footing.
